propositions: A new generator script must produce two standalone docs (config-reference.md and security.md) from typed config schema, deprecation registry, and secret-name inventory, leaving docs/config.md entirely unchanged.
The generator must support a --check drift-detection mode that returns nonzero when committed docs are stale, with newline-normalized comparison for CRLF safety.
Both generated docs must carry a top-of-file banner naming the generator command, and be registered in the GENERATED map and docs/README.md table for parity-gate enforcement.

Documentation must cover all required topics (precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, MCP/CLI exposure) via headings/anchors.
The generator's --check mode must run under make test with no CI provider dependency, and all existing consumers of docs/config.md must remain intact and passing.
